title: sentilab-open-transport-key/1
description: The preimage of the transport key (DESIGN rev 3 section 3.4): transport_key = "so1-" + hex(sha256(JCS(this object)))[0:48], 52 characters. room is the Senti room, account the poster's own account id (Senti's actorUserId), actor_slot "agent:<agentId>" or "human" as Senti stamps the row. logical_key is the proposal_key, the request_key, "team", or "publish:<proposal_sha256>" for a publish reply (not specified by rev 3; see CONTRACT.md). content_sha256 is the hash of the canonical salted plaintext (proposal_sha256 or request_sha256), the team hash or the publish hash, so re-sealing the same plaintext retries identically.
